title: Object-based encoding constrains storage in visual working memory
authors: William X. Q. Ngiam, Krystian B. Loetscher, Edward Awh
venue: Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 153(1), 86-101 (online 11 September 2023)
caption_short: General trial procedure of the whole-report experiments: fixation (1000 ms), memory array of six items (500 ms), retention (1000 ms), then recall at every placeholder; columns show the orientation, colour and conjunction conditions, and the middle column is the colour-only condition used here.
